source.content: public class RegexScalarTypeTarget { public String name; public RegexScalarTypeTarget() { name = 'made'; } }

public class RegexScalarHttpMock implements HttpCalloutMock { public HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest req) { System.assertEquals('https://example.test/regex-scalar', req.getEndpoint()); System.assertEquals('POST', req.getMethod()); System.assertEquals('trail', req.getBody()); System.assertEquals('yes', req.getHeader('x-local')); HttpResponse res = new HttpResponse(); res.setStatusCode(202); res.setStatus('Accepted'); res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain'); res.setBody(req.getBody() + ':response'); return res; } }

public class RegexScalarWebServiceMock implements WebServiceMock { public void doInvoke(Object stub, Object request, Map<String,Object> response, String endpoint, String soapAction, String requestName, String responseNS, String responseName, String responseType) { response.put('response_x', responseType + ':' + soapAction); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimePureRegexScalarCloseoutTest { @isTest static void regexAndScalarRows() { Pattern p = Pattern.compile('([A-Z]+)([0-9]+)?'); Matcher m = p.matcher('abc DEF42 ghi XYZ'); System.assert(m.find()); System.assertEquals('DEF42', m.group()); System.assertEquals('DEF', m.group(1)); System.assertEquals('42', m.group(2)); System.assert(m.find()); System.assertEquals('XYZ', m.group()); System.assert(Pattern.matches('[0-9]+', '12345')); System.assert(Pattern.compile('[a-z]+').matcher('trail').matches()); List<String> split = 'alpha,beta,,gamma'.split(','); System.assertEquals(4, split.size()); System.assertEquals('', split.get(2)); List<String> limited = 'one:two:three'.split(':', 2); System.assertEquals(2, limited.size()); System.assertEquals('two:three', limited.get(1)); System.assertEquals(13, Decimal.valueOf('12.5').round()); System.assertEquals(12.35, Decimal.valueOf('12.345').setScale(2)); System.assertEquals(1.3, Decimal.valueOf('1.25').setScale(1, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)); String encoded = EncodingUtil.urlEncode('a b+c/%', 'UTF-8'); System.assertEquals('a+b%2Bc%2F%25', encoded); System.assertEquals('a b+c/%', EncodingUtil.urlDecode(encoded, 'UTF-8')); String digestHex = EncodingUtil.convertToHex(Crypto.generateDigest('SHA-256', Blob.valueOf('abc'))); System.assertEquals('ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad', digestHex); Type targetType = Type.forName('RegexScalarTypeTarget'); System.assertNotEquals(null, targetType); RegexScalarTypeTarget made = (RegexScalarTypeTarget)targetType.newInstance(); System.assertEquals('made', made.name); } @isTest static void httpAndSoapRows() { Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new RegexScalarHttpMock()); HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); System.assertEquals(10000, req.getTimeout()); req.setEndpoint('https://example.test/regex-scalar'); req.setMethod('post'); req.setHeader('X-Local', 'yes'); req.setTimeout(5000); req.setBody('trail'); HttpResponse res = new Http().send(req); System.assertEquals(202, res.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Accepted', res.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('trail:response', res.getBody()); System.assertEquals('text/plain', res.getHeader('content-type')); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getCallouts()); Test.setMock('WebServiceMock', new RegexScalarWebServiceMock()); Map<String,Object> response = new Map<String,Object>(); WebServiceCallout.invoke(new Object(), 'request', response, new String[]{'https://example.test/soap', 'soapAction', 'requestNS', 'requestName', 'responseNS', 'responseName', 'ResponseType'}); System.assertEquals('ResponseType:soapAction', response.get('response_x')); System.assertEquals(2, Limits.getCallouts()); } }
